data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German name Alberic, meaning ‘noble, bright, or elf-like’. The name Ailbert is of Latin origin, composed of the elements ‘ad’ (noble) and ‘alber’ (bright or elf-like). The name Ailbert carries the meaning “Elf-bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ailbert usually hope their child will grow to embody elf-bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
